results.text:
Our supercompute site in Cochise County has been designed with Arizona in mind: no gas plant, no industrial water use, and a dry-cooling closed-loop water system. SpaceX will also invest $50B+ into the area, bringing 1,000 local permanent jobs and up to 5,500 construction jobs to the area. We will pay for our own power and pay $3.6B to upgrade the grid. Current residents will not subsidize this project – in fact, residential rates for SSVEC customers may decrease by up to 40%.

We value input from the local community, and we are looking forward to addressing questions during our planned meeting on December 9. We’re asking the Commission to keep it and let residents be heard. We think it's important these conversations happen publicly and in a timely manner. We are committed to helping build and grow the communities we live and work in for the better → http://spacex.com/sites/cochise-county#response
